title: Where Should Physics Enter a Molecular Crystal Generator?
abstract: arXiv:2609.36398v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative models make molecular crystal structure prediction fast, but their samples still exhibit geometric and packing violations. Physics can be introduced during training, post-training, or inference, yet these choices are rarely compared with the generator and physical signal held fixed. We introduce CrystAF, an all-atom crystal flow-map generation model, and use it with the UMA interatomic potential to systematically study where physics should enter. Post-training learns physical preferences directly into CrystAF, improving molecular validity and crystal packing while leaving sampling unchanged: physics is paid for once during training rather than repeatedly at deployment. In contrast, UMA relaxation is effective at repairing local clashes but makes generation 6--26$\times$ slower, while learning from relaxed targets provides little benefit. These routes are complementary rather than competing. Physics-informed post-training fir

translated_title: 物理学应该在哪里介入分子晶体生成器？
translated_abstract: 生成模型使分子晶体结构预测变得快速，但其生成的样本仍然存在几何和堆积方面的违规问题。物理学可以在训练阶段、训练后或推理阶段被引入，然而在保持生成器和物理信号固定不变的情况下，这些不同引入方式很少被系统比较。我们提出了CrystAF，一个全原子晶体流图生成模型，并将其与UMA原子间势结合使用，系统地研究物理学应该在何处介入。训练后学习将物理偏好直接融入CrystAF，在保持采样过程不变的情况下，提升了分子有效性和晶体堆积质量：物理约束的成本在训练时只需支付一次，而无需在部署时反复承担。相比之下，UMA弛豫虽然能有效修复局部原子冲突，但会使生成速度减慢6至26倍，而以弛豫后的结构作为学习目标则几乎没有收益。这些路线是互补而非竞争关系。
tldr: 该论文提出全原子晶体流图生成模型CrystAF，系统比较了物理学在生成模型中不同引入时机的影响，发现物理信息后训练能一次性提升分子有效性和晶体堆积质量且不影响采样速度，而推理时弛豫虽能修复局部冲突但使生成慢6至26倍，两种路线互补而非竞争。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CrystAF, an all-atom crystal flow-map generative model, and systematically compares where physics should enter the generation pipeline, showing that physics-informed post-training improves molecular validity and crystal packing at no sampling cost, while inference-time relaxation repairs local clashes but slows generation by 6-26x, making the two routes complementary rather than competing.
